title: Board Resolutions for General Retirement of Capital Credits (Patronage Capital)
content:
# General Retirement by Board Resolution

**Policy statement — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** General retirements are made only by board resolution, as recorded in the schedule of resolutions below, and are paid with the bills and check run of December of the resolution year (the general retirement payment month in every patron class).

## Method

Every patron class retires under the hybrid FIFO-and-percentage method. A resolution retires:

- **FIFO part:** everything still unretired of the distribution-margin allocations of every year up to and including its FIFO-through year; and
- **Percentage part:** its percentage of the *original* distribution-margin allocation of its percentage year.

Because every class retires wholesale-supplier allocations only when received, wholesale-supplier pass-through allocations are retired only for years up to and including the resolution's pass-through-through year, in full.

Each allocation year and source retired is its own retirement, rounded to the cent per allocation year and source, and becomes payable in full with no discount. A member cannot ask for a general retirement outside a resolution, and no general retirement is ever made on a fully retired account.

## Schedule of resolutions

| Resolution year | Approved | FIFO through allocation year | Percentage year | Percentage | Pass-through retired through allocation year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024 | 2024-11-19 | 2002 | 2017 | 15 percent | 1997 |
| 2025 | 2025-11-18 | 2003 | 2018 | 18 percent | 1998 |
| 2026 | 2026-11-17 | 2004 | 2019 | 20 percent | 1999 |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical member figures)

Under the 2026 resolution, a member whose account shows a 2004 distribution-margin allocation with $85.40 still unretired, a 2019 distribution-margin allocation originally $212.60, and a 1999 pass-through allocation of $31.15 still unretired has:

| Allocation | Retired under the 2026 resolution | Payable |
|---|---|---|
| 2004 distribution margin | $85.40 (all that remains; 2004 is the FIFO-through year) | $85.40 |
| 2019 distribution margin | $42.52 (20 percent of the original $212.60) | $42.52 |
| 1999 pass-through | $31.15 (in full; 1999 is the pass-through-through year) | $31.15 |
| 2005 distribution margin | nothing (later than the FIFO-through year and not the percentage year) | — |

The total is paid with the December 2026 bills and check run.
